name: application-guest-check-in-card
title: Guest Check-In Card
description: Hotel guest check-in card with the guest's avatar, reservation id, room/check-in/check-out stats, and Check in / Check out actions.
useWhen: Showing a hotel front-desk or self-service view of a single guest's reservation with room and stay dates.
Staff need immediate Check in / Check out actions attached to the reservation they affect.
You want a status pill (e.g. "Arriving today") that summarizes the reservation's current state at a glance.
avoidWhen: You're confirming a generic appointment or meeting booking, not a hotel stay — use `booking-confirmation-card` for that unrelated context.
There's no room assignment yet — drop the Room stat rather than showing a placeholder value.
You need a list of many reservations — use a table or list row pattern instead of repeating this card.
responsiveBehavior: Single-column card at a fixed max width; the three-stat row and the two-button action row each stay in fixed grids at any card width.
accessibility: Room/Check-in/Check-out use a <dl> so each stat has a programmatic label, not just visual proximity to its heading.
Check in and Check out are distinct, clearly labeled buttons rather than a single ambiguous toggle, avoiding accidental state changes.
The status pill conveys state through text ("Arriving today") in addition to its background tint, not color alone.

variants.title: Guest Check-In Card
variants.description: Maria Gonzalez, reservation #48213, room 412, Aug 8–11, with an amber "Arriving today" status and Check in/Check out actions.
accessibility: Check in and Check out are separate, explicitly labeled buttons so staff cannot mistake one action for the other.

variants.title: Guest Check-In Card (Dark)
variants.description: Guest check-in card adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Status pill and text colors are tuned to meet WCAG AA contrast against the dark surface.
